category: Open-Source AI App Builders & Autonomous SWE Agents

repositories.name: OpenHands
repositories.primary_strength: 65.8% SWE-bench Verified resolution with full bash, browser, and multi-file PR autonomy under MIT license
repositories.primary_tradeoff: Docker container sandbox startup adds ~4.5s cold boot and ~1.8GB RAM overhead locally

repositories.name: gpt-engineer
repositories.primary_strength: 55.0k+ star open-source CLI codegen pioneer (precursor to Lovable) for rapid greenfield repo scaffolding
repositories.primary_tradeoff: Optimized for initial repository generation rather than iterative multi-PR maintenance

repositories.name: Onlook
repositories.sandbox_runtime: Visual DOM-to-AST React & Tailwind Live Canvas
repositories.primary_strength: Visual 'Cursor for Designers' that maps live browser DOM edits directly back to React/Next.js + Tailwind AST code
repositories.primary_tradeoff: Specialized for React/Next.js and Tailwind frontend codebases rather than backend microservices

repositories.name: Dyad
repositories.primary_strength: Local open-source Lovable/v0/Bolt alternative with BYOK API keys, Supabase integration, and zero monthly credit caps
repositories.primary_tradeoff: Local Node/Vite preview server requires local dev dependencies installed on host machine

repositories.name: SWE-agent
repositories.primary_strength: Princeton/Stanford NeurIPS Agent-Computer Interface (ACI) with lint-guarded file editing and cybersecurity auditing
repositories.primary_tradeoff: CLI-first research architecture without a built-in visual web app preview canvas

repositories.name: bolt.diy
repositories.primary_strength: 100% MIT open-source fork of Bolt.new supporting Ollama, OpenRouter, Claude, and DeepSeek with zero $20-$50/mo token subscription lock-in
repositories.primary_tradeoff: Browser WebContainers cannot run native C++/Docker backend binaries directly in the tab
